# Route: routing-and-triggers

Author or evaluate discovery cases using catalog-visible metadata.

1. Inventory claimed triggers, exclusions, neighboring skills, explicit invocation, and host resolver behavior.
2. Write direct, indirect, incomplete, paraphrased, typo, negative, ambiguous, and collision cases.
3. Label train, validation, and protected holdout; keep holdout answers from the optimizer.
4. Record expected trigger, expected specialist/route when relevant, and exact catalog composition.
5. Run repeated routing trials when selection is stochastic.
6. Report confusion matrix, precision, recall, specificity, F1, trigger rate, ambiguity, and catalog recall when defined.

Do not tune the description against holdout. Proposed metadata changes belong to `skill-optimizer` or `skill-architect` and require a fresh candidate evaluation.
